verdict.rationale: cfo.ai is an AI-powered financial planning SaaS that processes users' financial data, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data-use policies, training exclusion, or an opt-out control. The per-tool allow/ask/deny policy and OAuth sign-in are adjacent access controls, not training-data protections, so they earn no credit.
